blocks.tamil_translation: he took off, put on clean clothes and went towards Rasulullah ﷺ. (At that time) Rasulullah ﷺ was reclining with his blessed (mubarak) legs stretched out. When Hazrat Ashajj (RA) came near him, the people made room for him, and the Prophet ﷺ, drawing in his legs, said, “O Ashajj! Sit here.” He sat on the right side of Rasulullah ﷺ; the Prophet ﷺ welcomed him, treated him affectionately, and asked him about the details of his region. He also mentioned each town of Hajar by name, saying names (of towns) such as “Safa' and “Mushaqqar'. Hazrat Ashajj (RA) said, “Ya Rasulallah, may my mother and father be sacrificed for you, you know the names of our towns better than we do.” “Your regions were opened up and shown to me, and I went about in them,” Rasulullah ﷺ said. Then, turning to the Ansar (the people of Madinah), he said, “O Ansar! Honour your brothers. For they are Muslims like you; their hair and the colour of their skin closely resemble your hair and colour. They have embraced Islam of their own will. They were not forced. (The Muslim army did not attack them and conquer them, and) all their wealth was not made spoils of war (ghanimah). Nor did they come to the state where they were killed because they refused to embrace Islam.” (Then that delegation stayed with the Ansar.) The next morning Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “How was the way your brothers (the Ansar) honoured you and showed you hospitality
